name: steam-mcp
display_name: Steam Research MCP Server — Games, Prices, Reviews & Player Analytics
description: Unofficial read-only Steam research through 8 compact game, player, review, community, search, analytics, and job tools.
long_description:
An unofficial, read-only Model Context Protocol server for Valve's public Steam APIs plus disclosed third-party sources for current SteamCMD AppInfo and market estimates. Eight compact tools cover store data, reviews, prices, tags, live players, current builds, public player data, libraries, achievements, community data, market analytics, and bounded analysis jobs. Official Steam facts remain separate from Gamalytic and SteamSpy estimates. The server never scrapes SteamDB and never writes, trades, posts, launches games, or makes purchases.

A free Steam Web API key is optional and is only needed for account-specific views and personalization. A Gamalytic key is optional; keyless public fields remain available. Friends lists, owned games, and achievements are visible only when the target Steam profile's relevant privacy setting is Public.

tools.name: steam_game_get
tools.description: Get a Steam game's store, technical, live, pricing, or multi-provider analytics view

tools.name: steam_player_get
tools.description: Get public Steam profile, social, library, wishlist, progress, or inventory data

tools.name: steam_search
tools.description: Look up or discover Steam games, deals, and charts

tools.name: steam_reviews_get
tools.description: Get a bounded Steam review summary or signed-cursor page

tools.name: steam_community_get
tools.description: Get Steam package, Workshop, or Community Market data

tools.name: steam_analyze
tools.description: Start one of eight bounded Steam analysis jobs

tools.name: steam_job_get
tools.description: Read Steam analysis job status or a bounded result page

tools.name: steam_job_cancel
tools.description: Request cooperative cancellation of a Steam analysis job

steam_api_key.title: Steam Web API Key (optional)
steam_api_key.description: Optional. Keyless game, store, review, price, AppInfo, and community views remain available; the key enables account-specific player views and personalization.

steam_user.title: Your Steam name (optional)
steam_user.description: Your public Steam vanity name, SteamID64, or profile URL. Single-player requests may default to it.

gamalytic_api_key.title: Gamalytic API Key (optional)
gamalytic_api_key.description: Optional. Enables fields included in your Gamalytic plan; the analytics view otherwise uses the keyless public field subset.
